description: This is a unit test class for the ModifyPolicyEntrySubstitutionStrategy in the context of placeholder substitution within policy modification commands. It verifies the immutability of the strategy and tests its behavior when placeholders are present or absent in the policies.

classes.name: ModifyPolicyEntrySubstitutionStrategyTest
classes.description: Unit test class for Verify behavior of ModifyPolicyEntrySubstitutionStrategy in placeholder substitution scenarios.

methods.name: assertImmutability
methods.description: Asserts that the ModifyPolicyEntrySubstitutionStrategy class is immutable.

methods.name: applyReturnsTheSameCommandInstanceWhenNoPlaceholderIsSpecified
methods.description: Tests that the apply method returns the same command instance when no placeholders are present in the policy entry.

methods.name: applyReturnsTheReplacedCommandInstanceWhenPlaceholderIsSpecified
methods.description: Tests that the apply method correctly replaces placeholder values in the policy entry when placeholders are present.
